answer: To enroll, an applicant splits a numbered shale tablet along its bedding plane. One half is wired to a surveyed stake in a marked river riffle; the mating half stays at a licensed raven loft. For forty-eight hours a banded bird flies a logged transect, photographs the submerged serial, and returns with a sealed GPS card. The mating faces, immersion log, and flight card are hashed into a slashable bond. Reusing a core or skipping the overflight voids the seat and burns the stake. A hundred fake identities therefore cost a hundred fresh cores, loft flights, riffle slots, and every lost bond.
